workload.prompt: Explain quantum entanglement in simple terms.

pair_note: Same-quant pair, shipped pinned default: stone-llama llama backend spawns '-c 8192 -fa on -np 2' (2x4096 slots after llama-server -fit divides the pinned 8192 across slots) on smollm3-q4km-test (identical Q4_K_M GGUF to ollama smollm3:3b). Re-measure BOTH engines in one session on port 5195 through the stone daemon, to give the README's decode-parity and concurrency bullets one same-basis set of numbers under the shipped config. Ollama probe-only (unload via keep_alive=0, never restart/kill). Round-2's pre-pin numbers (53.5 / 99.7) were measured at llama-server's old 4-slot auto-fit with 2048-token slots. GPU clock state recorded per measurement.
shipped_shape_note: llama-server -fit divides -c across -np: the pinned 8192 with -np 2 gives 2 x 4096-token slots; n_ctx_seq 4096, n_slots 2 confirmed in child log.

single_stream.basis_note: Two bases recorded: (a) client-side stream chunks/wall (128 chunks; warm runs 2-5), (b) llama-server's own eval time log lines. GPU boost state makes client wall vary (idle-clock 210MHz vs boost 2100MHz); the eval clock is the stable decode figure. Absolute decode for the shipped 2x4096 shape on this 4GB laptop GPU ranges ~40 tok/s (idle clock, 210 MHz) to ~55 tok/s (boosted, 1050-1207 MHz). Only within-session comparisons (e.g. -fa on vs off) are valid for flag A/Bs; cross-session absolute numbers track GPU clock state, not configuration. This session the card stayed boosted.
single_stream.gpu_clock_state: boosted (1050-1207 MHz SM during decode; idle 210 MHz between runs)

concurrency_4way.note: 4 parallel streams x 128 tokens, 3 reps, through the stone daemon (shipped -np 2 = 2 slots). Aggregate = total chunks / wall per rep. With 2 slots, 4 requests queue 2-at-a-time: TTFTs pair up (~0.1s then ~3s); aggregate ~87 tok/s. Honest cost of the shipped 2-slot shape vs the old 4-slot auto-fit's 99.7 (which used 2048-token slots).

eight_kb_unique_prompt.note: Unique 8 KB prompt per repeat (no server-side cache absorb), max_tokens=64, 3 reps. The pinned 2x4096 shape serves it at full speed — this is the collapse the pin exists for; no collapse observed.

ollama_sameday.note: Ollama same-day 2026-11-01, smollm3:3b Q4_K_M, same prompt/params as stone. Card cleared of stone via keep_alive=0 before each phase. GPU clock state recorded per run (system nvidia-smi).
